user.title: Geely Smart Charge & Climate
user.description: Select the Geely vehicle and nominal charging rate. Optional charger assistance can detect out-of-schedule charging before Geely reports it. Without a charger integration, STOP may be delayed by Geely polling. Only enable assistance for a charger dedicated to this Geely: sharing it with other vehicles can cause incorrect STOP requests. The integration never commands the charger.
